title: Colombian Civil War of 1854
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Colombian Civil War of 1854", at revision 1370611857, opens: "The Colombian Civil War of 1854 was a civil conflict that took place in the Republic of New Granada. It was the popular response supported by both Liberals and Conservatives against the coup d'état orchestrated by General José María Melo on 17 April 1854." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3118955, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item carries no description in English or Portuguese. Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
